modules.name: Project Delivery & Coordination
modules.description: Coordinate delivery, scope, dependencies, and communications for the four-month pilot.

tasks.title: Project management and delivery coordination
tasks.description: Plan and track delivery against the four-month pilot target; coordinate stakeholders, dependencies, decisions, risks, and scope across web, mobile, integrations, and migration.
tasks.rationale: Cross-team coordination and timely resolution of client dependencies are essential to delivering the pilot on schedule.

modules.name: Experience Design
modules.description: Define usable dispatcher and driver experiences for the pilot applications.

tasks.title: Dispatcher and driver experience design
tasks.description: Design key workflows, navigation, and responsive layouts for dispatcher job management and dashboard use, plus driver login, job handling, navigation handoff, and proof-of-delivery capture.
tasks.rationale: Both dispatcher and driver applications are in the assumed pilot scope; shared workflow design reduces usability and implementation risk.

modules.name: Dispatcher Web Application
modules.description: Build the dispatcher-facing web application, including operational administration and live dashboard views.

tasks.title: Dispatcher administration interface
tasks.description: Implement web interfaces to create, edit, list, and search jobs, drivers, and vehicles, consuming the corresponding backend APIs.
tasks.rationale: The dispatcher back office requires usable CRUD and search workflows for core operational records.

tasks.title: Dispatcher dashboard and map interface
tasks.description: Implement the dashboard showing today's jobs and a map view of driver positions, including loading, empty, and error states.
tasks.rationale: The dashboard combines operational job visibility with driver location information for dispatchers.

tasks.title: Jobs, drivers, and vehicles administration APIs
tasks.description: Implement backend data models and APIs to create, edit, list, and search jobs, drivers, and vehicles, with validation and appropriate access controls.
tasks.rationale: The web back office needs reliable server-side operations and data validation for its core records.

tasks.title: Today's jobs and driver positions API
tasks.description: Provide dashboard endpoints and data aggregation for today's jobs and current driver positions, including the location data needed by the map view.
tasks.rationale: The dashboard needs a backend source that combines current operational and location data.

modules.name: Driver Mobile Application
modules.description: Deliver driver workflows for authentication, job execution, and proof of delivery.

tasks.title: Driver mobile application workflows
tasks.description: Build the driver app experience for signing in, viewing assigned work, and completing delivery workflows, including photo and signature proof-of-delivery capture and submission.
tasks.rationale: Drivers need a mobile workflow to perform deliveries and capture the required evidence in the field.

tasks.title: Driver work-email authentication
tasks.description: Implement standard application authentication for drivers using their work email, including session handling and account access flows. Azure AD SSO is excluded unless separately confirmed.
tasks.rationale: Work-email login is explicitly required, while the assumption excludes unconfirmed enterprise SSO.

tasks.title: Proof-of-delivery storage and API
tasks.description: Implement secure APIs and storage for delivery photos and signatures, associate evidence with the relevant job, and expose delivery completion data to authorized users and integrations.
tasks.rationale: Mobile capture requires a backend path to persist and associate evidence with completed deliveries.

modules.name: SAP Business One Integration
modules.description: Exchange orders and delivery status with SAP Business One; invoicing remains in SAP.

tasks.title: SAP order import integration
tasks.description: Integrate with the client-provided SAP Business One interface to import orders on a 15-minute schedule, with validation, error handling, and operational logging.
tasks.rationale: Scheduled order import is a core dependency for populating delivery work; interface details and credentials are client-provided.

tasks.title: Delivery status updates to SAP
tasks.description: Send delivery status changes from the application to SAP Business One through the client-provided interface, with retry and failure handling.
tasks.rationale: The ERP must receive delivery outcomes while invoicing remains outside the new application.

modules.name: Mapping & Driver Location
modules.description: Support route and ETA information and provide driver positions for dispatch operations.

tasks.title: Mapping provider routes and ETA integration
tasks.description: Integrate with a mapping provider to obtain route and estimated-arrival information for relevant jobs and driver workflows.
tasks.rationale: Routes and ETAs depend on an external mapping provider and are required for delivery planning and customer updates.

tasks.title: Driver location capture and position service
tasks.description: Implement the mobile-to-backend flow for collecting and serving driver positions needed by the dispatcher map, subject to agreed location collection behavior and permissions.
tasks.rationale: The dispatcher map requires current driver positions; collection behavior and privacy details need confirmation during delivery.

modules.name: Customer Notifications
modules.description: Notify customers by SMS and email when a driver is on the way.

tasks.title: SMS and email on-the-way notifications
tasks.description: Implement notification triggers and provider integrations to send customers SMS and email when a driver is on the way, including delivery outcomes and failure handling.
tasks.rationale: The requirement specifies two notification channels and a delivery-status trigger; provider selection and message details need confirmation.

modules.name: Management Reporting
modules.description: Provide monthly KPI reporting and downloadable Excel output.

tasks.title: Monthly delivery KPI reporting and Excel export
tasks.description: Calculate monthly on-time delivery percentage and jobs per driver, present the results to management, and provide a downloadable spreadsheet export.
tasks.rationale: The KPIs require agreed definitions and aggregation over delivery data, with a spreadsheet export for management use.

tasks.title: Management KPI report interface
tasks.description: Implement the report interface for selecting or viewing monthly KPI results and downloading the Excel export.
tasks.rationale: Management needs an accessible interface to review the specified monthly metrics and obtain the export.

modules.name: Historical Data Migration
modules.description: Migrate the agreed subset of approximately 40,000 historical jobs from Access.

tasks.title: Access extract assessment and migration mapping
tasks.description: Assess the available Access extract, map source fields to the agreed application data model, identify data quality issues, and define migration validation rules.
tasks.rationale: Migration scope is limited to data needed by the application, and source structure and quality must be understood before loading.

tasks.title: Historical jobs migration
tasks.description: Build and run a repeatable migration for approximately 40,000 historical jobs from the extractable Access source, including transformation, load, reconciliation, and exception reporting.
tasks.rationale: A controlled, verifiable migration is needed to bring agreed historical job data into the new application.

modules.name: Privacy & GDPR
modules.description: Support deletion of driver location data upon request.

tasks.title: Driver location deletion capability
tasks.description: Implement an authorized process to locate and delete a driver's location data upon request, including deletion across relevant application storage and documented operational handling.
tasks.rationale: The stated GDPR need requires a reliable deletion capability for driver location data; retention and request-verification details should be agreed.

modules.name: Platform & Environments
modules.description: Set up delivery infrastructure and deployment pipelines for the pilot applications and services.

tasks.title: Application environments setup
tasks.description: Provision and configure the required development, test, and production environments and baseline application infrastructure for web, mobile services, integrations, and data storage.
tasks.rationale: Separate environments support safe development, integration testing, and pilot operation.

tasks.title: CI/CD pipelines
tasks.description: Set up automated build, test, and deployment pipelines for backend and web components, plus the agreed mobile build and release workflow.
tasks.rationale: Repeatable automation supports reliable integration and release within the pilot timeline.

modules.name: Quality Assurance
modules.description: Validate end-to-end behavior, integrations, migration, and regression readiness for the pilot.

tasks.title: QA and regression testing
tasks.description: Create and execute test coverage for dispatcher and driver workflows, authentication, integrations, notifications, reporting, migration reconciliation, privacy deletion, and cross-application regression; coordinate defect verification.
tasks.rationale: The pilot spans multiple applications and external systems, so end-to-end and regression testing are needed to validate the integrated scope.

modules.name: Engineering Governance
modules.description: Maintain code quality through peer review across implementation work.

tasks.title: Code review and engineering quality checks
tasks.description: Perform peer reviews of application, integration, migration, and infrastructure changes for correctness, maintainability, security, and adherence to agreed conventions.
tasks.rationale: Cross-cutting review helps catch defects and maintain consistent quality across the pilot implementation.
